verdict.rationale: llamafile itself runs an LLM that produces AI-generated answers on user-supplied input. You can chat through the built-in Web UI or CLI, upload images with `/upload`, and have a multimodal model describe them, all locally on your own device. It has no dedicated data-insight or suggestion feature, so getting 'insights from my data' means prompting a general-purpose model by hand. Missing for 10: built-in analysis of user datasets or files beyond images, proactive suggestions, structured insight features, and hands-on corroboration of data-insight use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
